A New Vision for a Healthier Future

SMOH is a team of young innovators passionate about science, medicine, and space health. We aim to develop creative solutions to health challenges through research, technology, and teamwork. We welcome curious students who want to learn, innovate, and make a difference.
summary:
Nabd is an autonomous, 100% offline health monitoring and therapeutic ecosystem designed to protect astronauts during Low Earth Orbit and deep-space missions where communication delays make ground support impractical. Built on Edge AI (TinyML) and calibrated using official NASA and CSA physiological datasets (HRP, OSDR, and Bio-Monitor), Nabd integrates three unified components to safeguard crew health 24/7:
1. Nabd Smart Watch (Active Safety): Continuously tracks heart rate, skin temperature, and blood oxygen saturation (SpO2). Using on-device TinyML models, it immediately detects hypoxia (SpO2 < 90%), thermal stress, or sudden incapacitation (high-G impact followed by 30 seconds of stillness), delivering silent haptic alerts and broadcasting automated SOS signals without manual input.
2. Nabd Smart Headset (Deep Sleep Induction): Counteracts severe circadian disruption (16 sunrises and sunsets daily) without sleeping pills. Upon detecting early fatigue via forehead PPG sensors, the open-ear bone-conduction headband automatically plays dual-channel binaural beats (104 Hz left, 108 Hz right) to generate a 4 Hz Delta wave, inducing Slow-Wave Sleep and fading out smoothly once deep sleep is confirmed.
3. Nabd Offline App: Serves as the central local dashboard, unifying biometric analytics, alerts, and mission health logs with zero internet connectivity.
details:
The Nabd Smart Headset is an autonomous, 100% offline neuro-acoustic wearable engineered to combat astronaut fatigue and circadian rhythm disruption during spaceflight. In Low Earth Orbit, crews experience 16 sunrises and sunsets daily alongside microgravity stressors, leading to chronic sleep loss without safe pharmacological options.
Integrated into the Nabd health ecosystem, the soft, open-ear headband operates as a closed-loop Edge AI system:
1. Autonomous Fatigue Detection: Forehead PPG sensors continuously monitor heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) locally. When on-device AI detects early fatigue or circadian misalignment, it automatically initiates the sleep protocol without manual input.
2. 4 Hz Delta Wave Entrainment: Dual temple transducers deliver pure sine waves of 104 Hz to the left ear and 108 Hz to the right ear. Through the brain's Frequency Following Response, this generates a 4 Hz phantom beat within the Delta band (0.5–4 Hz), naturally promoting restorative Slow-Wave Sleep.
3. Adaptive Fade-Out & Safety: Once biometrics confirm stable deep sleep, the audio gradually fades to zero to protect hearing and conserve power, while the open-ear bone-conduction design ensures spacecraft emergency alarms remain clearly audible.
